protocol.selection: Per city, maximum mean period-specific daily OOF R2 on common valid days across eight fixed variants; tie by listed order. Evaluate readiness on all usable selected-design OOF days, regardless of whether it passes.
protocol.normalisation: Identical joint complete observed weather/seasonal donor draws pooled across 2015-2019 and 2024-2025 per city. Hold period and within-period trend fixed; no trend bridges the gap.
protocol.normalised_intervals: 500 year/seven-calendar-day block resamples of normalised daily values with centred week-CV daily residuals added for conditional target-variability uncertainty. No model-parameter or station-network uncertainty.
protocol.timestamps: Never choose a source-clock shift to improve scores. Require source or cross-provider evidence. Rebin cached quarters to IST hours without rewriting original observations.
